en: Black‑and‑white view of a hillside in a European town, showing several large, old residential buildings with steep tiled roofs and many small rectangular windows. The left building has a small half‑timbered tower or bay and a stepped gable, while the right building has a curved, Baroque‑style gable. The houses are set above terraced gardens or vineyards overgrown with vegetation; in the foreground are lower rooftops with clay tiles and chimneys. The scene has an early‑20th‑century photographic style and no visible border text on the front.
